description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy, in percentage values, for different model configurations. The horizontal axis displays the categories: “Ours”, “w/o comments”, “w/o select”, “w/o emotion”, “w/o cognition”, “Ours”, “w/o comments”, “w/o select”, “w/o emotion”, and “w/o cognition”, listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 75.0 to 95.0, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5. There are ten vertical bars, each representing a specific model configuration. The first set of five bars are colored in shades of red, ranging from a lighter shade for “w/o comments” at approximately 80.10 to a darker shade for “Ours” at 89.84. The second set of five bars are colored in shades of blue, ranging from a lighter shade for “w/o comments” at approximately 83.02 to a darker shade for “Ours” at 90.57. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and the first bar in each set is visually emphasized with a darker shade.
